# Caller codegen audit

The diagnostic premise was too strong: Clang already unswitches the dynamic mask6
loop. Its repeated body has no output-mask test. Fixed caller still changes register
assignment,callsite/layout and surrounding code. These are confounded here;no causal
predictor/cache claim or referee replacement is justified. Counts below are whole-
function static instructions/conditionals,NOT executed per-element counts.
